posts.body_html:
All photos below are Courtesy of Brooks Garcia.

Here's a photo of Bob Hanrahan's property in the southern part of Baldwin County, Alabama. S. leucophylla naturally grew on this property, and Bob introduced pretty much everything you can imagine to his Bog. He religiously cares for it and burns the bog to keep the plants happy. This is where S. x Adrian Slack was noted as being worthy of a cultivar:





Conecuh National Forest after a late summer burn Oct. 2003:



Jim Miller checking out S. flava var. rugelii's in the Apalachicola National Forest, Liberty Co, FL:




A friend of Brooks, Ann, standing amongst S. flava var. rubricorpora Liberty Co, FL:




S. flava var. rubricorpora growing in the Hypericums, Liberty Co, FL:
